summary: Add missing server-owned percentage and EUR discount codes across operator editing, cart, exact payment totals and financial projections
evidence: Owner explicitly requests editable10/20percent and5/10EUR coupons. Current canonical service, schema, operator navigation and one-page buyer SDK have no coupon support. Existing immutable quotes, orders, permissions, shipping fingerprint, Stripe amount verification and analytics require a single integrated implementation; a browser-only subtraction would break those contracts.
rollback: Disable owner codes through versioned admin before reverting buyer UI; retain additive0027tables and immutable discounted order snapshots, redemptions and use counts. A pre-discount payment adapter cannot process those new discounted pending orders; retain the small settledLines payment/projection support or stop new checkout until an explicit compatible recovery. Preserve actual production bindings, orders, stock, mail, cron and all historical migrations. No schema/data reset or active production test coupon.
